ranked_facts.concept_key: AFB PCR probe of hilar lymph node
ranked_facts.why: The positive AFB PCR probe of hilar lymph node is more likely to be associated with Tuberculosis, which is a type of Granulomatous Disease, than with Infectious Diseases such as Bacterial, Fungal, or Viral Sinusitis.

The presence of noncaseating granulomas in the sinus mucosa is more characteristic of Sarcoidosis, a type of Granulomatous Disease, than of Neoplastic Diseases such as Sinonasal Undifferentiated Carcinoma, Esthesioneuroblastoma, or Squamous Cell Carcinoma of the Sinuses.
